SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'collected_at',now(),'transaction_read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
 'postgres_version',current_setting('server_version'),'session_role',current_user,
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'name',p.proname,'types',oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes),
   'identity',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),
   'result',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),
   'language',l.lanname,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'settings',p.proconfig,'acl',p.proacl::text,
   'source_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex'),
   'effective_execute',jsonb_build_object('anon',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
     'authenticated',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
     'service_role',has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
     'postgres',has_function_privilege('postgres',p.oid,'EXECUTE'))
  ) ORDER BY p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes))
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='public'),
 'default_acl',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),
   'schema',CASE WHEN d.defaclnamespace=0 THEN '*' ELSE d.defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,
   'object_type',d.defaclobjtype,'acl',d.defaclacl::text)) FROM pg_default_acl d
   WHERE d.defaclnamespace IN (0,'public'::regnamespace)),
 'relations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,
   'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,
   'options',c.reloptions,'acl',c.relacl::text) ORDER BY c.relname)
   FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
   WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','S')),
 'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',con.conname,
   'type',con.contype,'validated',con.convalidated,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid)) ORDER BY c.relname,con.conname)
   FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'),
 'column_acl',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'column',a.attname,'acl',a.attacl::text) ORDER BY c.relname,a.attname)
   FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
   WHERE n.nspname='public' AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attacl IS NOT NULL),
 'role_flags',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',rolname,'superuser',rolsuper,'inherit',rolinherit,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls))
   FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')),
 'repair_objects',jsonb_build_object('wallet_transaction_funding',to_regclass('public.wallet_transaction_funding') IS NOT NULL,

queries.financial_preflight:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('collected_at',now(),
 'funding_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.wallets w WHERE w.balance IS DISTINCT FROM
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(l.remaining_amount),0) FROM public.wallet_funding_lots l WHERE l.wallet_id=w.id)),
 'overheld_wallets',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.wallets w WHERE w.balance <
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(h.amount),0) FROM public.wallet_holds h WHERE h.wallet_id=w.id AND h.status='active')),
 'overallocated_lots',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.wallet_funding_lots l WHERE l.remaining_amount <
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(a.amount),0) FROM public.wallet_hold_allocations a JOIN public.wallet_holds h ON h.id=a.hold_id WHERE a.lot_id=l.id AND h.status='active')),
 'expired_active_holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.wallet_holds WHERE status='active' AND expires_at<now()),
 'duplicate_provider_refund_id_groups',(SELECT count(*) FROM
  (SELECT provider,provider_refund_id FROM public.wallet_refund_items WHERE provider_refund_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY provider,provider_refund_id HAVING count(*)>1) d),
 'expired_hold_states',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (
 SELECT h.order_type,e.status AS execution_status,
 (coalesce(e.carrier_in_flight,false) OR coalesce(h.carrier_in_flight,false)) AS in_flight,
 e.reloadly_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AS has_provider_identity,count(*) AS holds
 FROM public.wallet_holds h LEFT JOIN public.topup_executions e ON e.wallet_hold_id=h.id
 WHERE h.status='active' AND h.expires_at<now()
 GROUP BY h.order_type,e.status,(coalesce(e.carrier_in_flight,false) OR coalesce(h.carrier_in_flight,false)),e.reloadly_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) x)
) AS financial_preflight;

 FROM cron.job j JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM cron.job_run_details d WHERE d.jobid=j.jobid ORDER BY d.runid DESC LIMIT 1) d ON true
 WHERE j.jobname='refresh-usage-forecasts';
queries.critical_grants:
SELECT c.relname,r.role,has_table_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'TRUNCATE') AS truncate,
 has_table_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'REFERENCES') AS references,has_table_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'TRIGGER') AS trigger,
 has_table_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'MAINTAIN') AS maintain FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES('anon'),('authenticated')) r(role) WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN
 ('wallets','wallet_transactions','wallet_funding_lots','wallet_holds','sim_setup_orders','scheduled_topups','return_trip_packages','provider_offers')
 ORDER BY c.relname,r.role;
